assay: bulk RNA-seq, mouse liver (DA.p1: GSE239729 holds the RNA-seq of Fig. 3a,b,f and Supp. Fig. 2o)
primary_estimand: Paper's RNA-seq estimand: hepatocyte Cdo1 knockout (Cdo1-LKO) vs WT (Cdo1 flox/flox) liver transcriptome in HFD-fed mice WITHOUT exercise (S2.3.p1, FIG3 a, S4.19.p1). The requested estimand (exercise effect) is not part of the sequenced design.
sample_inclusion: n = 3 WT + 3 Cdo1-LKO, HFD-fed, sedentary (FIG3 a: 'HFD-fed mice without exercise', n = 3 mice per group)
planned_contrasts: Cdo1-LKO vs WT, HFD sedentary (FIG3 a; paper: 630 up / 672 down = 1302 DEGs at p < 0.05)
exercise_contrasts_in_paper: Exercise effects (WT/LKO x sedentary/exercise, Fig. 2d design, n = 6) are measured only by RT-qPCR, western blot, mitoDNA and histology (Fig. 1b, 3c-e); none were sequenced.
paper_method: DESeq2 1.20.0 on Hisat2-aligned reads (S4.19.p1); two-sided Wald test

paper_threshold.source_locator: FIG3 a ('p < 0.05'; 'Two-sided Wald tests without adjustment')
